description: Verified JSM binding/mechanic semantics (the candidate lane). Pipeline: synthetic uinput pad -> real JSM binary (this fork, branch-a-port, build-linux/, clang + SDL3 3.4.8) -> evdev capture. Only trace-verified entries; hypotheses live in kb/lab-notes/.

entries.semantics: Digital button to key, exact press/release count and order, ~2 ms latency at evdev.

Press shorter than HOLD_PRESS_TIME fires tap binding on release; longer fires hold binding AT the threshold and suppresses tap. HOLD_PRESS_TIME is GLOBAL (one value for every binding — no per-binding hold time). Wall-clock boundary = threshold + up to ~1 poll tick (~8-16 ms slack); 150/155 ms still tap at setting 150, hold by 170 ms.
First press fires the BASE binding immediately (base echo always present); a second press inside DBL_PRESS_WINDOW fires DOUBLE. Window epoch: first-RELEASE-to-second-DOWN (proven by construction).
BTN while MOD held fires CHORD, overriding BTN's base binding; BTN alone fires its base. Member-leak (MOD carrying its own binding during the chord) is UNTESTED — the verifying trace bound MOD=NONE.

DEGRADED: chord itself correct (suppresses both members' bindings), BUT persistent sticky state — a lone member press after any chord re-emits SIM instead of the lone binding; 100-1000 ms gaps do not clear it, only JSM restart/reconnect. degraded_approximation for any layout reusing a chord member as a lone button. Root-cause hypothesis (getMatchingSimBtn state-equality) is source-review grade, see lab notes.

entries.syntax: ZR = SOFT ; ZRF = FULL ; ZR_MODE = NO_SKIP
entries.semantics: Fires off the analog ABS_RZ axis threshold (not a digital latch): soft pull -> SOFT held; full pull adds FULL while keeping SOFT; release drops both. ANY crossing counts — an instant 0->255 single-event jump fires soft+full ~3 ms apart.
Directional key held while the stick is tilted past the inner deadzone — exact stick-to-keys.
One key-down -> held state -> one key-up; no re-send chatter.
